tests.name: Diagnostic Error Stream Separation (`2>`)
tests.description: Verifies that the database check isolates stderr (File Descriptor 2) to '/var/log/db_errors.log' without polluting stdout.
tests.failure_message: Error stream redirection failed. Use '2>' to redirect standard error (File Descriptor 2) to an error log file.

tests.name: Combined Stream Merge Redirection (`2>&1`)
tests.description: Verifies that both stdout and stderr are captured into '/var/log/full-incident.log' using '2>&1' stream merging.
tests.failure_message: Merged stream redirection failed. The syntax '> /var/log/full-incident.log 2>&1' sends stdout to the file and merges stderr into the same stream.

tests.name: Inter-Stage Stream Binding Invariants
tests.description: Verifies that all intermediate nodes (stages 1, 2, 3, 4) take input from 'stdin_from_pipe' and produce 'stdout_to_pipe'.
tests.failure_message: Pipeline stream binding violated. In a Unix pipeline, intermediate commands must read from standard input (stdin) provided by the upstream pipe rather than reading separate file arguments.

tests.name: Status Code Filter Precision in `grep`
tests.description: Verifies that the grep filter accurately searches for HTTP 500 status codes in access logs.
tests.failure_message: Grep stage failed to isolate HTTP 500 error rows. Ensure the grep arguments specify the error code '500'.

tests.name: Sorting Invariant Preceding `uniq -c` Aggregation
tests.description: Verifies that the 'sort' command immediately precedes 'uniq -c', satisfying the POSIX requirement that uniq only detects adjacent duplicate lines.
tests.failure_message: Sorting invariant violated! In Unix, 'uniq' only groups adjacent identical lines. A pipeline must execute 'sort' immediately before 'uniq' to aggregate duplicate log entries accurately.

tests.name: Triage BUG-01: Redirection vs. Pipe Syntax Confusion
tests.description: Verifies diagnosis and correction for 'cat log.txt > grep ERROR', replacing '>' with '|'.
tests.failure_message: Triage for BUG-01 failed. Using '>' instead of '|' creates a file on disk rather than streaming data to the next command. Use '|' to pipe data into grep.

tests.name: Triage BUG-02: Stderr Leakage to Terminal Screen
tests.description: Verifies diagnosis and correction for 'check-services | wc -l', adding '2>&1' to route error stream into the line counter.
tests.failure_message: Triage for BUG-02 failed. The standard pipe (|) only redirects stdout (1). Stderr (2) leaks to the terminal unless merged using '2>&1'.

tests.name: Triage BUG-03: Accidental Log Truncation Prevention
tests.description: Verifies diagnosis and correction of destructive single '>' overwrite in recurring log recording, replacing with safe append '>>'.
tests.failure_message: Triage for BUG-03 failed. Using single '>' in a recurring logging loop wipes previous audit logs. Use double '>>' to append safely.
